intro: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips from CAVA offer a flavorful twist on traditional pita chips with savory garlic and creamy ranch seasoning. These baked chips provide a satisfying crunch as a standalone snack or perfect complement to any bowl or pita. At 280 calories with 10g protein, they are a popular choice on the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) for guests seeking bold flavor.
priceCalories: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips are priced at $2.75 to $2.95 depending on location, delivering excellent value for a shareable side. Each serving contains 280 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile of 10g protein, 42g carbs, and 10g fat. This makes them a moderate-calorie addition when exploring the [full CAVA menu](/). The pricing remains competitive across all CAVA locations nationwide.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets Garlic Ranch Pita Chips apart is the signature blend of aromatic garlic and tangy ranch seasoning on perfectly baked pita. Unlike standard chips, these are baked rather than fried, creating a lighter yet satisfying crunch. The dual-flavor profile offers more complexity than Classic Pita Chips, making them a standout option on the [CAVA Sides Menu](/menu/sides) for flavor enthusiasts.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Garlic Ranch Pita Chips delivers 280 calories with 10g protein, 42g carbohydrates, and 10g fat. The protein content makes these chips more substantial than typical snack options. With moderate calories, they fit well into various dietary plans when tracked using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator). The baked preparation method keeps the fat content reasonable compared to fried alternatives.
whatsInside: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips feature baked pita bread as the base, seasoned with a proprietary blend of garlic and ranch flavoring. The pita provides a sturdy, crispy texture while the seasoning delivers savory, herbaceous notes with creamy ranch undertones. Quality ingredients ensure consistent flavor in every bite. This simple yet effective combination makes them a versatile pairing for items from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads).
tasteLike: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips taste like a harmonious blend of savory garlic with cool, tangy ranch seasoning on a crispy baked pita base. The garlic provides aromatic depth while the ranch adds creamy, herbaceous notes reminiscent of dill and buttermilk. The baked pita offers a satisfying crunch without greasiness. This flavor combination is bold yet balanced, appealing to those who enjoy robust seasonings.
customize: While Garlic Ranch Pita Chips come pre-seasoned, you can customize your CAVA experience by pairing them with various dips and spreads. Consider adding Crazy Feta, Hummus, or Harissa for complementary flavors. These chips work excellently alongside any creation from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls). You can also order multiple side options to create a shareable appetizer spread for groups.
pairsWell: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips pair exceptionally well with cooling dips like Tzatziki or Hummus from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/dips-spreads). They complement Mediterranean bowls featuring grilled chicken or falafel perfectly. The ranch flavor also balances spicy options like Harissa-based dishes. These chips work as a crunchy contrast to softer bases from the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) like RightRice or SuperGreens.
healthyChoice: As a baked rather than fried option, Garlic Ranch Pita Chips offer a lighter alternative to traditional chips. With 10g protein per serving, they provide more nutritional value than standard snack chips. The 280-calorie count is moderate, fitting into balanced meal plans when portioned appropriately. Check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for specific dietary considerations and ingredient transparency before ordering.
howToOrder: To order Garlic Ranch Pita Chips, visit any CAVA location or order online through their app. Simply add them as a side to your bowl, pita, or salad for $2.75 to $2.95. You can also order them separately as a standalone snack. Find your nearest location using the [CAVA Locations](/locations) page. They are available during all operating hours at participating restaurants nationwide.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Pita Chips at $2.55 to $2.95, Garlic Ranch Pita Chips offer more complex seasoning at a similar price point. Harissa BBQ Pita Chips provide a spicier alternative at the same 280 calories and matching price. Whole Pita at $2.25 to $2.55 offers 320 calories with a softer texture. The garlic ranch seasoning makes these chips ideal for those preferring creamy, savory flavors over plain or spicy options.
whoShouldTry: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips are perfect for ranch dressing enthusiasts and garlic lovers seeking a Mediterranean twist. They appeal to customers who want more flavor than plain chips without excessive heat. Health-conscious diners choosing baked over fried options will appreciate the preparation method. Anyone building a custom bowl from the [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) looking for a complementary side should consider these flavorful chips.
worthTrying: Garlic Ranch Pita Chips are absolutely worth trying for their unique flavor profile and satisfying crunch. At $2.75 to $2.95, they provide excellent value as a shareable side or standalone snack. The baked preparation and 10g protein content offer nutritional advantages over typical chips. Whether you are a CAVA regular or first-time visitor, these chips deliver a memorable taste experience that keeps customers coming back.
